records.source_locator: Printed pp.14-15 / PDF pp.4-5, Andean heritage and pre-Inca maize/potato food systems
records.geographic_basis: Explicit Cusco agricultural-system crosswalk covering the existing Acamama province. Regional crop availability inferred from longstanding Central Andean cultivation; not nine individually dated archaeological finds. Source maize presence is corroborated near the Sacred Valley by marcacocha_crop_history_evidence.json. Physical altitude/suitability and accessible land remain separate.
records.interpretation: The pre-Inca system contains maize and Andean potatoes.1337 denotes modeled pre-contact availability, not a dated sample. White-potato is the existing Solanum tuberosum crop key, not proof of modern cultivars. No potato10t/ha estimate, imperial acreage, extra harvest, irrigation or population floor is adopted.
